content:
Kiran Nair: quick sketch — proposing a store-and-forward gateway for air-gapped customers. gateway pulls deltas once from an online mirror, shards large bundles, produces resumable 'packages' for operator transfer. reduces retries and makes seed caches smaller. thoughts?

Maria Chen: +1 on resumable packages. main question: signing/attestation. offline site needs to verify chain without network access. do we do a single envelope signature or per-shard signatures? :thinking_face:

Jon Patel: per-shard signatures are safer for partial transfer recovery, but more expensive to verify. operationally, i'd prefer a two-level signature: manifest signed by org key + per-shard hashes signed by gateway key. that lets verifier check manifest chain quickly.

Olivia Park: edge case: operator aborts mid-apply (powercut). we need an activation handshake + idempotent apply. propose: write-to-staging then atomic rename to active; activation marker with signed epoch. rollback = activate previous marker.

Kiran Nair: agreed. also adding a small index file for quick integrity checks before full apply. sample manifest:```
version: 1
release: 2026-03-20
components:
  - name: runtime
    shards: [runtime-1.bin, runtime-2.bin]
    manifest_sig: sig_v1
  - name: runtime-checks
    shards: [checks.sha256]
    manifest_sig: sig_v1
index_sha256: abcd1234...
```

Maria Chen: nice. verifier flow on airgap: 1) operator copies files 2) run offline-verifier --manifest index.yaml --trust-anchor /etc/redwood/anchors 3) verifier checks chain and marker signatures. need to document how trust-anchor rotation works for long-lived installs.

Jon Patel: UX idea: `rictl seed push --gateway <ip>` to pre-populate operator USB/transfer node. gateway exposes resumable HTTP endpoints with range and shard metadata. also expose quick-delta patch endpoints so we don't always ship full images.

Olivia Park: about backpressure: gateway should rate-limit per-customer and expose small bloom filter of available shards for quick existence checks. that prevents wasted transfers. bloom false-positive rate baked into manifest so verifier tolerates small extra fetches.

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: latest hosted mirror snapshot size = 12.1GB (2026-03-20T10:12:03Z) :package:

Kiran Nair: rollback heuristics — we should keep N last activation markers (N configurable, default 3). activation window: only allow activate if health-checks pass for 30s. otherwise auto-rollforward to previous marker. keep logs of marker signatures and operator ack.

Maria Chen: compatibility matrix: add a serialized 'compat' section in manifest listing runtime ABI + ABI-checksum to avoid applying incompatible shards. manifest consumer must refuse apply on mismatch.

Jon Patel: performance targets for gateway: 95th percentile resume latency < 200ms, per-shard throughput 100 MB/s on commodity infra. prototype should include transfer bench and verifier CPU profile.

Olivia Park: security note: gateway private keys must be HSM-backed and we should support dual-signature (org + gateway) to allow traceability. document key rollover steps for offline sites (pre-signed cross-cert blobs).

Kiran Nair: next steps: i'll update the RFC with: store-and-forward gateway architecture, manifest format (index + per-shard sigs + compat), activation marker lifecycle, verifier CLI UX, and operator seed commands. action: @Maria to draft verifier doc, @Jon to sketch rictl UX, @Olivia to write activation failure modes. will prototype gateway in Q2. :thumbsup:
